blocks.text: CHICAGO— Anthony Davis had 36 points and 11 rebounds, and the Washington Wizards beat the Chicago Bulls 98-94 in an NBA Cup game on Friday night. AJ Dybantsa had 20 points, 10 rebounds and six assists for Washington, which posted its second straight win after an eight-game losing streak. Trae Young scored 16 points, and Kyshawn George finished with 11.
